Does this sound familiar?

The hardest part isn’t what happened. It’s not knowing what comes next.

  • One day you’re sure you’re leaving. The next day, you’re not.
  • Everyone has advice for you, and none of it feels like yours.
  • You keep replaying what you found out, looking for the answer in it.
  • You want to make the choice you won’t regret five years from now.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why the decision feels impossible right now

And why going back and forth is normal, not a sign you’re getting it wrong.

The questions that matter more than “can I forgive him?”

A simple way to separate what you feel today from what you want for your life.

What to look for in his response

The signs worth paying attention to before you decide anything.

How to handle the people pushing you to decide

What to say to friends and family so you can take the time you need.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Do I need to be leaning one way already?

No. The class is for women who are unsure, and for women who are leaning one way and want to check it.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch privately when it suits you.

Is this therapy?

No. It’s a coaching and education class with practical tools. It isn’t therapy and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, get clear on your options, and decide afterwards if you want support.

Script 1 · “Everyone has an opinion”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“When a woman finds out about an affair, everyone suddenly has an opinion on what she should do.”

Body

“Her best friend says leave. Her mum says stay. And she goes back and forth ten times a day. The problem isn’t that she can’t decide. It’s that she’s trying to decide with everyone else’s voice in her head. What helps is a process: a few honest questions, in the right order.”

CTA

“I teach that process live in The Stay or Go Masterclass. It’s 60 minutes, $17, and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, soft natural light, your usual setting. On-screen text: “stay or go?”

Script 2 · “Not ready to decide”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“It’s okay not to know yet whether to stay or go.”

Body

“A lot of women feel like they have to decide right away after an affair, or they’re weak. They don’t. Rushed decisions in either direction are the ones people tend to regret. What matters is knowing what you need to see, from him and from yourself, before you choose.”

CTA

“In my live masterclass I walk through exactly what that looks like. $17, replay included. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, slower pace, one cut to a text card listing “what to know, what to see, what you want”.

Script 3 · “Staying well, leaving well”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“There are two good outcomes after an affair. Most people only talk about one.”

Body

“Some women stay, and build something honest. Some women leave, and build a life they love. Both can be the right choice. What usually goes wrong isn’t the choice itself. It’s making it before she’s clear on what each path asks of her.”

CTA

“The Stay or Go Masterclass shows both paths, side by side. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, split-screen text “staying well” and “leaving well”.

After an affair, everyone has an opinion on whether she should stay or go.

Friends say leave. Family says stay. Her own mind says both, depending on the hour.

The pressure to decide fast is usually the loudest voice in the room.

Clarity doesn’t come from more opinions. It comes from a process.

What she needs to know. What she needs to see from him. What she wants for herself.

In 60 minutes, Betrayal and Infidelity Coach Amanda Lennon walks through that process live.
